svg.title: What remains of a collected fee
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-fee-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: What remains of a collected fee; subtitle: Business contribution, not the estate distribution; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD; first and last bars are totals, middle bars are signed deductions. Assumed lawful fee is $6,000 on $60,000 recovered.; caption: A $6,000 fee less $1,200 records, $800 review and $1,000 allocated acquisition leaves $3,000 before overhead, owner pay and tax.; stages: label: Collected fee; value: $6,000; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Opening total: a hypothetical 10% fee, only if lawful for this claim.; label: Records and research; value: -$1,200; numeric value: -1200.0; detail: Direct evidence costs, including paid research labor.; label: Professional review; value: -$800; numeric value: -800.0; detail: Business-paid review; not an asserted statutory charge.; label: Acquisition allocation; value: -$1,000; numeric value: -1000.0; detail: Allocated costs include unsuccessful leads, not just this winner.; label: Contribution; value: $3,000; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Closing total, not an additional movement and not owner net profit.
